'''Rod Latham Corulag Drain''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/bb4.htm Corulag Drain], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
